method: Identical current source compiled at 200 and 500 optimizer runs with Solidity 0.8.38. The selected 500-run build is compared with the 200-run reference using one fixed 200-run harness and receiver. All measured writes, including every redemption, use the strict less-than-1-percent gate. Read-only execution costs are reported separately and do not gate release. Deployment gas comes from local Prague Anvil receipts. Temporary baseline regeneration does not modify repository snapshots or historical reports.

reproduction.harness: All variants use one legacy/200 harness and MinimalGasReceiver. Candidate creation bytecode is loaded with vm.getCode and deployed using CREATE at identical addresses, preserving signed calldata.
reproduction.measurement: All 160 measurements use Forge --isolate. Write measurements include transaction intrinsic/calldata gas and refunds; Separate benchmarks sum 15 isolated single-unpack calls with snapshotValue. Read measurements are callee STATICCALL execution. Setup and harness gas are excluded. Deployment gas comes from actual Prague Anvil receipts, reverting to identical account state and nonces for each variant.
reproduction.environment: FOUNDRY_* and DAPP_* overrides are removed for isolated builds. Tracked sources and normal gas snapshots are never modified. The compiler baseline is rewritten only with --update-baseline.
